### Bug Description

hi, I did binary search and found out that the most recent Sodium for 1.21.11 causes distant kelp flickering for me. changing settings didn't resolve the issue

### Reproduction Steps

go to for example /locate biome minecraft:cold_ocean, set your distance to 16, and fly around

It stops when I turn block animations off with external mod (Sodium Extra) but doesn't get resolved when disabling 'animate only visible textures'

[comment by krxl-temp (none)]
also stop when using (outdated) kelp animations remover resource pack so it's that fault

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
The resource pack seems to just replace the textures so there's only one sprite per sheet, but doesn't actually replace the [`.mcmeta` file](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Resource_pack#Texture_animation) that configures the animation. Maybe this is causing adjacent texture data to be incorrectly accessed in Sodium?

[comment by krxl-temp (none)]
@jellysquid3 seems possible, consider the fact that flickering only happens to some states of the animation
